summary: Backend + frontend testing of the new CAM tab (phasage caméras) and MATERIEL tab (drill-down 3 niveaux) on /suivi (chef) and /suivi/terrain/{token} (public). 13 new pytest cases in test_suivi_cam_materiel.py + all 20 previous tests → 33/33 pass. Frontend chef and terrain both verified via Playwright: cam-card, cam elements (with red '12 ×2' duplicate), cam inputs reel/geo (blur-save), cam-geo-warn/explain/comment, cam-move select (N-labels), cam-validate/block/comment; materiel-night-2 with 7 products (990 mm, Caméra noire, ES 1.5/2.1, SA 1.5/2.1/2.1 Freezer noirs), materiel-unassigned block, drill-down to allée toggle showing 'Élément 12 → Caméra noire ×2' + '(sans élément) → 6 produits', materiel-back button OK. Dashboard geoloc alerts (2) still displayed. Terrain 3-tab nav (pose/cam/materiel) fully functional. Regression: pose EEG allée-card still rendered on terrain.
critical_code_review_comments: suivi_deploy.py:398-430 — _build_state produces both 'element' key in materiel/{nuit} response and cam.allees list. Consistency: pose uses 'numero' terminology elsewhere; the materiel per-element bucket uses key 'element'. Not a bug, just note for future consistency.

SuiviCam.jsx auto-opens the first non-complete night with allées — good UX. When user changes geo to close the gap, cam-geo-warn and cam-geo-explain unmount and input reference is detached (expected React behavior, not a bug).
CamAlleeUpdate accepts cameras_reel/cameras_geo as Optional[float] ge=0 → negatives rejected (422) verified. Bad status → 400 verified. Terrain endpoint mirror OK.
SuiviMateriel.jsx (150 lines) is compact and easy to maintain; getMateriel + getMaterielNuit loading is fast (<300ms). Loader is shown during transition.
Terrain public endpoints /allee-cam and /materiel(/{nuit}) have no rate limiting — same recommendation as iteration 13 (public token endpoints deserve rate limits before production).
